verdict.rationale: Reimbursements are a fair axis for a spend management platform. The evidence covers corporate cards, card transaction reconciliation, generic "automated expense reporting, approvals" marketing, and accounts-payable Pix payments, but none of it documents an employee submitting an out-of-pocket expense and being reimbursed by direct deposit with submission-to-payout tracking. Expense reporting and Pix vendor payments are adjacent features and earn no credit.
